clips.title: The story
paras: Warden Thelwater calls for help as the Stockade erupts in riot beneath Stormwind. Defias prisoners have seized the cell blocks, and he wants the uprising crushed before the city's leaders learn how badly the prison has failed.

The Stockade holds criminals, conspirators, and outlaws who threaten the Kingdom of Stormwind. Imprisoned Defias operatives have launched a sudden, violent uprising and taken the cell blocks from the guards. Armed felons crowd the corridors, and the usual order has broken down. The guards now depend on visiting champions to fight through the riot and retake the prison.

Warden Thelwater orders Defias prisoners killed on sight out of desperation and fear for his position. He suspects foul play behind the coordinated mutiny. If the House of Nobles or the wider nobility learns the Stockade is out of control, he fears he will lose his post. Thelwater hopes a death sentence for insurgency will break the inmates' resolve and crush the rebellion before word passes the canal gates.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The uprising must be quelled! I need your assistance. If word gets out that the prison is overrun I will lose my job! This is a case of foul play if I've ever seen one. But what's important now is forcing these prisoners into submission for the safety of Stormwind.
The punishment for insurgency is death. Kill some of these deviants! That ought to get things under control.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The Stockade is still overrun! These Defias Rats must be shown that their actions will not be tolerated. Now get back down there and show some force!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Your efforts in The Stockade were valiant, friend. It's obvious this problem is bigger than the both of us. But you have performed well and for that I am thankful.
